controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery on this radar model. The 1994 equatorial radar geometry leaves north–south ambiguity: local feature latitudes and thickness are model-dependent. This view retains the archived 1999 radar model; the reference radius is derived from this mesh volume and is not an independently measured physical mean radius. No resolved optical surface map is supplied. Lighting uses the published pole and arbitrary display phase.

controls.description: False color shows radius at the nearest source-surface point minus a 1.284042 km reference sphere. It includes global shape, not gravitational height or independent measured topography. Correspondence farther than 30 m is withheld. The 1994 equatorial radar geometry leaves north–south ambiguity: local feature latitudes and thickness are model-dependent. This view retains the archived 1999 radar model; the reference radius is derived from this mesh volume and is not an independently measured physical mean radius.
